Hi, I’m Lauren Daly! I’m currently a junior at Quinnipiac University pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Marketing with a minor in Social Media Strategy. I’m passionate about creativity, communication, and connecting with others. Outside of school, I work at my dance studio at home, which has given me the opportunity to grow both personally and professionally. Through my experiences in school and at the dance studio, I’ve developed strong communication, leadership, teamwork, and organizational skills that I’m excited to bring into future internships and career opportunities.

What I'm working on

Marketing

Coursework that turns theory into practice

In organizational management I'm studying how teams are structured and led, and in operations and supply chain I'm mapping how a product actually moves from supplier to shelf. On the marketing side I'm digging into consumer behavior — why people buy, and what they scroll past — and developing brand voice, then applying it: taking a strategy brief and building the content calendar and posts that come out of it, the kind people save and send to a friend.

Dance Studio

Internal work at my dance studio

Working at my dance studio has given me experience that goes far beyond teaching classes. I help keep classes organized and scheduled, welcome and communicate with dancers and their families, and support the promotion of our annual concert and other studio events. Being able to work alongside the same leaders I have looked up to since I started dancing has taught me how important communication, teamwork, creativity, and responsibility are when creating a positive experience for both students and families. These experiences have helped me become more confident working with people, taking initiative, and balancing multiple responsibilities — skills I hope to bring into a future career in marketing and social media.

Quinnipiac

Studying marketing and social media strategy

At Quinnipiac, I'm building a strong foundation in marketing while also studying social media strategy. My classes are helping me strengthen my skills in areas like communication, branding, consumer behavior, and understanding how businesses connect with their audiences. I'm constantly learning new ideas that I can apply to real-world situations, while balancing a full course load with being part of dance company. Managing both has helped me become more organized, dependable, and comfortable working under deadlines, and I'm excited to continue building the skills I can bring to a future internship and career in marketing.

A little about me

I'm in my junior year at Quinnipiac University studying marketing, drawn to the part of the field where creative instinct meets what the numbers say.

Back home in New Jersey I work at my dance studio, where years of classes turned into a job I love — helping run the schedule, keeping families in the loop, and promoting the shows we spend all year building toward.

Dance taught me discipline and reading a room. Marketing gave me a language for it. I'm looking for internships where both are useful.
